name: Score
why: A repo's page score, from a live reading to the issue or card each miss becomes
ideal: Each number is read live, rated against a sourced goal and rolled up. A ranked queue turns each miss into an issue or card.

sources.title: Google SRE book: service level objectives
GitHub Docs: Rate limits for the REST API
GitHub Docs: Managing issue types in an organization

steps.name: Collect
tools: gh api, within the hourly quota
steps.rule: Collectors read each metric live within the hourly API quota. One they cannot read is not measured, never 0.

steps.name: Rate
steps.rule: A metric scores 100 at its goal, 50 when near and 0 when it misses. Each goal names its source.

steps.name: Roll up
tools: The CI and local runs, merged
steps.rule: A tab is the mean of its quality, speed and consumption. The master is the mean of the three.

steps.name: Queue
steps.rule: The work queue ranks each miss by the points a fix adds. No open issue waits past two days.

steps.name: Issue
steps.rule: A quick-list miss opens one typed issue with an area label. A closed issue is never reopened.

steps.name: Card
steps.rule: Any other miss becomes a draft card with a picture and a table, Done when the metric meets.
